summary: DSA Signage describes itself as a made-in-the-USA manufacturer of static and digital drive-thru menu board systems and indoor menu systems, citing '45+ years' of experience partnering with national restaurant brands. (Scope note: Self-reported company history; no independent corroboration of the 45-year figure found.)

DSA Signage's food & beverage industry page displays customer logos/case references including Starbucks, Dave's Hot Chicken, and Slim Chickens as brands it has supplied menu board/drive-thru signage to. (Scope note: Customer logos on a vendor's own marketing page; not confirmed by the named brands or third-party reporting, and scope/scale of each relationship is unstated.)

DSA Signage markets a double-lane digital drive-thru menu board system, citing a Slim Chickens installation intended to improve drive-thru throughput; no quantified before/after metrics are disclosed. (Scope note: No independently reported throughput or sales-lift numbers; claim is directional marketing language only.)
